question: when the wall bounce happens inside the context window (frames 1-8 show the reflected motion), does the predictor forecast continue the reflected heading or revert to the incoming one?

data.rendered: 96 configurations x 3 kinds (bounce, straight_in, straight_out) with the run_temporal_contact renderer (wm.render_twin RenderParams, MPEG-4 codec round trip, grey 6 px wall bar on bounce clips only), elastic reflection at k_b in 2..6 (0-indexed frame; frames k_b..7 of the context are post-contact), speeds 2/3/4 m/s, incidence 20-65 deg from the normal

definitions.turn_fraction: signed angular move of the read angle from theta_in along the shorter arc toward theta_out, over that arc (0 = incoming, 1 = reflected); same function and (theta_in, theta_out) pair for all three kinds
definitions.straight_in: primary control: same start, speed, theta_in throughout, no wall (turn fraction expected ~0)
definitions.straight_out: reference: constant velocity along theta_out throughout, no wall (what the reader gives for pure theta_out motion; expected ~1)
definitions.forecast: bf16 context-only encode (frames 1-8) + predictor (mask index 0), step-pooled; read by per-future-step ridge probes fit on the native fp32 forecast cache of the 480 probe-role direction clips; steps 0-3 = frames 9-10 ... 15-16 (1-indexed), all post-contact
definitions.enc16: per-tubelet probes on the stored fp32 16-frame timepool of the 750 constant-velocity clips (same readers as p5_contact_dynamics (a)); full-clip attention sees frames 9-16 too
definitions.ctx8: per-tubelet probes fit here on the bf16 context-only encoding of the same 750 velocity clips, applied to the rendered clips' context-only encoding (what the predictor reads)
definitions.random_enc16: enc16 with the random-init copy (seed 0) and probes on its stored timepool; the forecast is not run with the random-init encoder (trained predictor, untrained inputs: the stored forecast readers do not apply)
definitions.phase: tubelet t (frames 2t, 2t+1, 0-indexed): pre if 2t+1 < k_b, post if 2t >= k_b, else straddle

bounce_relative_to_references_step_mean.definition: (bounce - straight_in) / (straight_out - straight_in) of the step-mean forecast turn fraction

parity_fp32_timepool_rel_maxabs_vs_store.ctx8_vs_stored_16frame_note: context-only encoding differs from full-clip encoding by construction; no stored parity reference

forward.precision: 16-frame timepool fp32 (TF32 off); context encode + forecast bf16 autocast, fp32 residual (as run_temporal_contact)
